bubbles.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I will now play for you the rondo "Alla Turca."
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I'm terribly sorry. I seem to be having a little bit of trouble with my piano!
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Dad! I want to be the piano.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: Dad! She's had this many turns!
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: You can be the bum bongos!
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Bum bumda bum, bum bongos! Bum, bumda, bum...
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: This episode of Bluey is called "The Magic Xylophone"!
bubbles.speaker: 片名报幕 · 说话人待核

bubbles.text: Quick, Bingo! Get the dinger thing!
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Let me up! Let me out of here!
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Mum, come and look at this!
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Oh, look! It's just like when we first met.
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: What?! How did I get fingers up my nose?
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Oh, what a splendid mustache you have.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: It's my turn to unfreeze him.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: Bluey, you're taking all the turns freezing.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: Come on, Bingo. Let's get the teddies.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Mum! Mum! Look at dad now!
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: This loose hair's been bugging me all morning.
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: Mum, Bluey's not letting me have any turns.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: Bluey, if you don't take turns with people, people won't take turns with you.
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: But Bingo's too slow. Dad will catch her.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: You can either take turns or I'll bring the xylophone to work with me.
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: Well, you know what to do, then.
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: I'll see you later. Just make sure you unfreeze him for toilet breaks, okay?
bubbles.speaker: 妈妈 · Mum

bubbles.text: Here, Bingo. But stand right back here.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: That way, you could get a head start. He runs really fast when he's mad.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Where are they?! I can't find them anywhere!
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: I can't hear him. I think we should freeze him, just in case.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: No, I want to freeze him! You've had all the freezing turns.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: You ding-dongs were too busy squabbling.
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Now, look at this lovely new garden gnome.
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Ahh. This is the perfect spot.
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Oh! Wait a minute! It's got a little bit of felt pen on the fingers.
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Thanks, Bingo. Dad's gone to get the hose.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Bluey, you always never take turns with me.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: You just take all of the turns. And it makes me feel sad.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: I will unfreeze you if you promise you will let me have turns, too.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo

bubbles.text: Gonna hose my [歌词待核]... I'm gonna hose it good.
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: Okay, time for a little bath, garden gnome!
bubbles.speaker: 爸爸 · Dad

bubbles.text: We tricked you! Bingo unfroze me. I was just pretending.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: Here, Bingo. You can unfreeze him.
bubbles.speaker: 布鲁伊 · Bluey

bubbles.text: I like the daddy water fountain.
bubbles.speaker: 宾果 · Bingo
